requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding MX RDATA.
requirements.required_behavior: Place the PREFERENCE field first, followed by the EXCHANGE field.
requirements.why_checkable: MX RDATA serialization and parsing can be checked for the field sequence shown in the format diagram.

requirements.quote:
PREFERENCE      A 16 bit integer which specifies the preference given to
                this RR among others at the same owner.  Lower values
                are preferred.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding the PREFERENCE field of an MX RR.
requirements.why_checkable: The field width and integer representation can be inspected in the codec and checked using encoded records.

requirements.quote:
PREFERENCE      A 16 bit integer which specifies the preference given to
                this RR among others at the same owner.  Lower values
                are preferred.
requirements.condition: When comparing MX RRs at the same owner using their PREFERENCE values.
requirements.required_behavior: Prefer an MX RR with a lower PREFERENCE value over one with a higher value.
requirements.why_checkable: A pair of MX records sharing an owner and having different preference values gives a concrete ordering check.

requirements.quote:
EXCHANGE        A <domain-name> which specifies a host willing to act as
                a mail exchange for the owner name.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding the EXCHANGE field of an MX RR.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent EXCHANGE as a domain name.
requirements.why_checkable: The EXCHANGE encoder and parser can be checked for use of the domain-name representation.

requirements.quote:
EXCHANGE        A <domain-name> which specifies a host willing to act as
                a mail exchange for the owner name.
requirements.condition: When interpreting the EXCHANGE field of an MX RR.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret EXCHANGE as identifying a host willing to act as a mail exchange for the RR owner name.
requirements.why_checkable: The record interpretation can be checked for mapping the owner name to the exchange host named by EXCHANGE.

requirements.quote:
MX records cause type A additional section processing for the host
specified by EXCHANGE.
requirements.condition: When performing additional-section processing for an MX record.
requirements.required_behavior: Perform type A additional-section processing for the host specified by EXCHANGE.
requirements.why_checkable: The MX additional-processing path can be checked for its requested RR type and its EXCHANGE-derived target name.
